expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.Ulat===4.5 && S.R===0.4 && S.alku===0 && S.t===0 && S.Rs===0.1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: U_lat = 4,5 V, R = 0,40 ohm, empty cell, t = 0, R_s = 0,10 ohm (must run before any setup)
on load: I = (4,5 V - 3,40 V) : 0,50 ohm = 2,2 A (lesson-answers sim-I)
on load: terminal voltage U = E + R_s I = 3,62 V (sim-U)
on load: time to full 1,25 h · ln(1,1 : 0,30) = 1,624 h (sim-tfull)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const ok=(r,a,b,s)=>r.min===a&&r.max===b&&r.step===s; return R.length===4 && ok(R[0],'0','4','0.1') && ok(R[1],'3','5','0.1') && ok(R[2],'0.1','1','0.1') && ok(R[3],'0','100','10') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: four sliders: t 0-4,0 h by 0,1; U_lat 3,0-5,0 V by 0,1; R 0,1-1,0 ohm by 0,1; start level 0-100 % by 10

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='R,Ulat,alku,t' && P.Ulat.unit==='V' && P.R.unit==='Ω' && P.t.unit==='h' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares t (h), Ulat (V), R (ohm) and alku (%)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?1080:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x1080 (circuit, cell and graph stacked, larger labels) under 500 px
the readout shows the current, the level and the efficiency
